atoms.b:
Scene_1: Rachel_and_Joey_sit_on_a_sofa,_snow_is_falling_outside_the_window. Dad_enters_the_room.

Dad: ((Kids, let’s get the house in order for Mum. I bet it would make her happy to come home to a clean house after a long day of working at the hospital.))

Rachel: (annoyed) Dad,_you_know_I’m_allergic_to_scented_soap. No_way_am_I_doing_the_washing_up.

Joey: (rolling_his_eyes) You’re_not_even_allergic,_you’re_just_making_that_up!

Dad: ((Stop it, Joey.)) (frustrated) ((And Rachel, you could hoover instead, that would help me out a lot.))
